weekendPlanner.title: This weekend: winter season on the Peninsula
weekendPlanner.dek: Winter is the Peninsula's quietest season. A few well-chosen moves make it its most rewarding.

cards.title: Red Hill Truffles, winter truffle hunt, Main Ridge
cards.note: Périgord black season is in full swing and the post-King's Birthday booking window is the most available of the truffle calendar. Pizza hunts from $189pp, lunch bundles from $195pp, private hunts from $120pp minimum. Booking required.

cards.title: Foxeys Hangout Vegetable Feast, Morning Sun Vineyard
cards.note: Seasonal vegetable feast lunch with matched wines, $85 per person. Confirm the date is running via foxeys-hangout.com.au before heading out. Booking recommended.

cards.title: Mornington Racecourse Monthly Market
cards.note: Handmade goods and local produce at 320 Racecourse Road, Mornington. 9am to 2pm. Free, walk-in. Unhurried, local in texture, the right scale for a Sunday morning before lunch.

cards.title: Stonier 2025 Pinot Noir, week two, Merricks
cards.note: Post-long-weekend Stonier is the cellar door at its quietest: staff available for a proper conversation, the 2025 Pinot Noir still there to sit with. Walk-in, cellar door hours.
